## Checklist (case studies)

If you are adding or editing a case study, confirm:

- [ ] Copied `templates/design-template.md` and filled in all seven framework sections
- [ ] Includes numbers in the estimation (QPS, storage per year, bandwidth, cache size)
- [ ] Has one deep dive with at least two options compared and a stated choice with tradeoffs
- [ ] Lists bottlenecks and tradeoffs (SPOF, hot keys, failure behavior, year 3 growth, monitoring)
- [ ] Ends with follow-up questions to practice
- [ ] Linked from `case-studies/README.md` (table + suggested order)
- [ ] Linked from the main `README.md` learning path
- [ ] Marked as Solved or Practice in the case-studies table
- [ ] Scored with `docs/grading-rubric.md` — aim for no 0s

## Checklist (general)

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] I used tables and diagrams over long prose where it helps
- [ ] Every technology choice includes a reason
- [ ] I checked that links work (no broken cross-references)
- [ ] I did not include credentials, API keys, or internal hostnames
